Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

IS: 11943 (Part 12) -1987 



Indian Standard 
SPECIFICATION FOR HARD METAL BURRS 

PART 12 INVERTED CONE BURRS (TYPE N) 



( Reaffirmed 2003 ) 



1, Scope — Covers the dimensions and other requirements of hard metal burrs of inverted cone 
shape. Type N. 

2. Dimensions

3. General Requirements — For requirements not covered in this standard it shall conform to 
IS ; 11943 ( Part 1 ) - 1987 'Hard metal burrs: Part 1 Technical supply conditions'. 

4, Marking — Shall be marked with the designation code and the manufacturer's nam3 or trade- 
mark. 

4,1 Certification Marldng — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This Part 12 of the standard covers the hard metal burrs of Type N. The different types of the 
hard metal burrs are covered in Parts 2 to 12 and the technical supply conditions are covered in 
Part 1 of this standard. 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from ISO 7755/12- 
1984 'Hard metal burrs— Part 12 Inverted cone burrs (style N )', issued by the International Organi- 
zation for Standardization ( ISO ). 



Adopted 10 March 1987
